front.title: Outerprise Ecosystem and Infrastructure: An Examination Manual for Detached Evidence Delivery

abstract.t: This document describes repeatable procedures for examining detached evidence packets and the signed findings returned by recipients. It identifies the object, criterion, evidence, procedure, observed result and limits of each finding. The procedures cover artifact identity, release consistency, consent and access, delivery events, benchmark comparisons, commitment openings and policy decisions. Synthetic examples illustrate reproducible checks. The document adapts an examination manual into an implementation-neutral method.
